reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Sponsoring Syrian orphans and widows in Al-Fayhaa and Al-Wurud housing and the host community in Irbid Governorate in Jordan 2021

description.narrative: 1. A monthly cash guarantee to improve the standard of living for Syrian orphans and widows and the host community for a full year. 2. An annual cash guarantee to provide the educational needs of Syrian orphaned children and the host community in the study stage (once at the beginning of the new school year). 3. Providing the Eid clothing for orphans and widows twice during the duration of the project and bringing joy and happiness to them.
Providing monthly living guarantees to 56 beneficiary families to improve the livelihoods of members of these families and provide their basic needs, and provide educational guarantees

Providing monthly living guarantees to 56 beneficiary families to improve the livelihoods of the members of these families and provide their basic needs, and providing a one-time educational guarantee during the project period and at the beginning of the school year to help school-aged children meet their necessary school needs, and providing Eid clothes twice during the project period to achieve Joy and pleasure and ensuring their inclusion in the host society.
